evidenceBoundary: The Zenodo record describes a real cross-process manufacturing dataset with two injection-moulding streams sampled at approximately 1 kHz and two downstream screw-driving streams sampled at 833.33 Hz. The injection streams are highly relevant to MouldMaster, but downstream screw-driving samples cannot enter injection-moulding totals and target/reference fields cannot be counted as measurements. The record is openly accessible, yet the specific deposited dataset licence was not rendered during review. Zenodo requires public files to carry a licence and defaults new deposits to CC BY 4.0, but MouldMaster does not infer the record-specific licence from that default. Automated raw retrieval and promotion therefore remain blocked until the exact reuse terms are captured.
